_note: SkyReels-V2 image-to-video prompts, one per start picture (animeA/NAME.png), in its own caption style: shot type and angle, subject, action, setting, camera. The bat is named once. seconds 4.04 = 97 frames (the model's most), 3.04 = 73. Made with --mode fast --steps 4 --size 960x544, 2 seeds a picture; a picture used by two shots gives each shot a different take.

t01.prompt: Anime style, medium shot, eye level, front view. The camera tracks back slowly in front of him.
